tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the led suit. When void you must trump. Points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2 (120 per deal).
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Click a playable card to select it. A King + Queen of the same suit is a marriage: leading one sets that suit as trump and scores 40/60/80/100 for ♠/♣/♦/♥.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. Leading a King or Queen of a marriage declares trump.
tutorial.info: Tysiąc (Thousand) is a Polish 3-player 24-card trick-taker. First a Bid phase (raise +10 or pass) decides the Declarer, who exchanges via the Talon (give one card to each opponent) and must meet the contract. Marriages (K+Q) set trump and score 40/60/80/100 by suit. The first player to reach the target (default 1000) wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
